title: Automatic code hover from a ggplot expression — ch_hover
text: code plot code. Either expression wrapped braces, example , character string/vector code lines. type (string) Hover effect: "incremental" (default, highlights hovered row every prior row) "one_row". layout (string) Placement image relative code table: "auto" (default) puts side side room wraps image otherwise (responsive); "row" forces side side, shrinking image needed; "column" forces image code. fixed_scales (logical) Default FALSE: step shows true output partial code, axes legends may change steps. TRUE pins scales, axes panel layout final plot reveal visually stable (mechanism borrowed ggreveal package Weverthon Machado). width, height (numeric) Image size inches. Default 7 x 5. dpi (numeric) Image resolution. Default 96. path (string) Default NULL: step images written temporary folder, embedded HTML base64 deleted. Give folder path (e.g. "codehover_assets/") keep numbered PNG files disk reference relative path instead (smaller HTML, folder must ship page). name (string) File-name prefix step images. Default "codehover". css_class (string) Extra CSS class added container. alt (character) Alternative text step images, used screen readers. Either one string per step single string reused every step. Default NULL builds "Plot step n: <code>". caption (string) Optional caption shown image. initial (string number) step's image shown interaction: "last" (default), "first" step number. env Environment code evaluated. Default `parent.frame()`.

text: First stable release, full rewrite package. previous release GitHub 0.0.1.

title: codehover 1.0.0
text: ch_hover() new main entry point. Give ggplot code (inside braces, character vector) splits code every top-level +, renders one image per step returns self-contained hoverable table: ch_hover_chunk("label") code named knitr chunk, plot can live normal eval=FALSE chunk. Output self-contained: CSS JavaScript travel object htmltools dependency, step images embedded base64. template, YAML set-, jQuery. Works R Markdown, Quarto RStudio viewer. fixed_scales = TRUE pins scales, axes panel layout final plot reveal visually stable (mechanism borrowed ggreveal package Weverthon Machado). default, FALSE, shows honest output partial step. layout controls placement image: "auto" (responsive, default), "row" "column". path = keeps numbered PNG files disk links instead embedding , pages many steps.
code: ch_hover({   ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +     geom_point() +     geom_smooth(method = "lm") })

title: codehover 1.0.0
text: Rows now respond tap keyboard, mouse hover: rows focusable (tabindex="0"), Arrow /moves Enter/Space activates one. Hover tables previously unusable phones tablets. Images carry alternative text. ch_hover(alt =) sets per step (default: “Plot step n: ”), ch_row(alt =) manual API. caption = adds caption image; initial = chooses step’s image shown interaction ("last" default).

title: codehover 1.0.0
text: CSS exposes custom properties theming, e.g. plus --codehover-highlight-fg, --codehover-font-size, --codehover-gap, --codehover-row-padding, --codehover-tab --codehover-focus. dark-scheme default applied automatically via prefers-color-scheme. image box reserved plot’s aspect ratio, page longer reflows hovered image shown, step images preloaded path = used (flicker first hover). Indentation emitted <span class="ch-tab1"> … <span   class="ch-tab16"> instead invalid custom elements <tab1> … <tab16>. old tags still styled, hand-written tables earlier versions keep working.
code: .codehover { --codehover-highlight: #cde7ff; --codehover-font: monospace; }

title: codehover 1.0.0
text: flipbookr longer used suggested. old automatic mode depended flipbookr internals; package now splitter. ch_out() returns renderable htmltools tag list, string. wrap htmltools::HTML() : R Markdown templates changed. code-hover--flipbookr quick_graphical_code_hover removed. now two templates: codehover (automatic) codehover-manual. Documents longer need copy codehoverStyle.css / codehoverJavascript.txt next .Rmd – delete files includes: YAML entries. Invalid type layout values now raise error instead silently falling back default. Rows linked image data-link attribute (inline onmouseover handler), fixed img_holder id gone, several tables can live page Quarto longer strips attribute.
code: # before htmltools::HTML(ch_out(x, img = "final.png")) # now ch_out(x, img = "final.png")

title: codehover 1.0.0
text: # inside string (e.g. color = "#1D8565") longer treated start comment splitting code.
